description.text: atis was developed to meet the demands of an evolving relationship with food. Today, food is a story of satisfaction, personal health, sustainable sourcing and community building – so much more than just the fuel and convenience of past times. We resolved to create a space here in London that was truly reflective of the modern approach to eating. A space to serve plant-powered food that not only tastes delicious but reflects the common values of a growing global community: a community that thinks about sourcing, packaging, ethical relationships and the environment. We call this ‘powerful food’: food that tastes good, and does good – for the body, the soul and the planet.
